name: Better Squads
author: SCUMSA
description: Squad-only chat, in game. Alerts when a squadmate connects, disconnects, is killed, gets a kill, has their base raided, or the squad roster changes — every line a template with live tokens, including {sector} and reader-relative {distance}/{direction} that tell each member how far the event is from where THEY are standing. Plus a full in-game command set players run themselves: the roster with sectors and distances, rally, squad message, route to your base, squad info, and per-event self-mute — every subcommand renameable. Cooldown, quiet hours and admin mute on top. Nobody outside the squad sees a word. Requires the SSA Bridge.

needs.why: Reads where each squadmate is standing NOW, so {distance} and {direction} tell a player which way to walk rather than where somebody was at the last game save.
Reads the squad roster the game itself holds, so a player who has just joined is told and one who has just left stops hearing the squad's private messages — neither has to wait for a save.
